data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Alber', meaning 'noble, bright, or eloquent'. Alberico may refer to Saint Alberic, a 6th-century Italian saint. Parents who choose Alberico usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alberico total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
